rules.statement: Section 27B(1) does not apply with retrospective effect.
rules.supporting_quote: He accordingly submitted that as the Order under Section 14(2) was made in June 1974 and Deed No. 2085, by which the Plaintiff derived her title, was executed in 1980, prior to Act No. 39 of 1981, the provisions of Section 27B has no application in this case.
